document: Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Six Months Ended 30Th September, 2026 2 Nov - ITC Q2 FY27 results approved; Sproutlife amalgamation and Century Pulp acquisition disclosed.
text:
Notes: 
1.
The unaudited· Standalone Financial Results, Segment Results, Balance Sheet and Statement of Cash Flows were
reviewed by the Audit Committee, and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on 2nd
November, 2026.
2.
The continuing significant brand building costs covering a range of personal care and branded packaged food products
are reflected under 'Other expenses' stated above and in Segment Results under 'FMCG-Others'.
3.
10,48,850 Ordinary Shares of t 1/- each were issued and allotted under the Company's Employee Stock Option
Schemes during the quarter ended 3oth September, 2026. Consequently, the issued and paid-up Share Capital of the
Company stands increased to t 1253,05, 17,081 /- as on 30th September, 2026.
4.
The Company on 1st August, 2026 completed acquisition of the pulp and paper business of Aditya Birla Real Estate
Limited, operated under the name of 'Century Pulp and Paper', along with the assets, liabilities, contracts, employees
etc., as a going concern on a slump sale basis, in accordance with the Business Transfer Agreement dated 31st March,
2025.
The fair value of assets and liabilities of 'Century Pulp and Paper' have been provisionally determined and recorded in
accordance with Ind AS 103 - 'Business Combinations'. Accordingly, the financial results of the Company and
'Paperboards, Paper & Packaging' segment include those of 'Century Pulp and Paper' from 1st August, 2026 and
consequently are not comparable with previous periods.
5.
The Company on 28th September, 2026 acquired additional 13,445 Equity Shares of t 10/- each of Sproutlife Foods
Private Limited ('Sproutlife'), consequent to which Sproutlife became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with
effect from the said date.
Further, the Board of Directors of the Company at the meeting held today i.e. 2nd November, 2026 has approved,
subject to necessary approvals, the Scheme of Amalgamation of Sproutlife Foods Private Limited, with the Company
under Sections 230 and 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. Pending approval, no effect of the same has been given in
these Results.
6.
Exceptional Items for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 of t 25.66 crores represent expenses
incurred in relation to the acquisition of the pulp and paper business of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, operated under
the name of 'Century Pulp and Paper' (Refer Note 4 above).
Exceptional Items for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2025 of t 88.08 crores represent final
settlement of the insurance claim towards leaf tobacco stocks, which were destroyed due to fire at a third party owned
warehouse in an earlier year.
7.
Consequent to expiry of the GST Compensation Cess, the Government of India increased GST and Central Excise duty
on cigarettes with effect from 1st February, 2026. In accordance with Ind AS 115 - Revenue from Contracts with
Customers and Schedule Ill to the Companies Act, 2013, GST and GST Compensation Cess are excluded from Gross
Revenue from sale of products, whereas Excise duty is not excluded. Consequently, Gross Revenue from sale of
products and services and Excise duty for the quarters ended 30th September, 2026, 30th June, 2026 and six months
ended 30th September, 2026 reflect the impact of sharp increase in Excise duty and are not strictly comparable with
those of the previous periods.
8.
This statement is as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2015.
Limited Review 
The Company is required to file its financial results with the relevant stock exchanges as required under Regulation 33 of the 
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, the financial results have been 
subjected to Limited Review by the Statutory Auditors of the Company, who have issued an unmodified report on the same.

document: Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Six Months Ended 30Th September, 2026 2 Nov - ITC Q2 FY27 results approved; Sproutlife amalgamation and Century Pulp acquisition disclosed.
text:
Notes: 
1.
The unaudited Consolidated Financial Results, Segment Results, Balance Sheet and Statement of Cash Flows were reviewed by the Audit
Committee, and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on 2nd November, 2026.
2.
The continuing significant brand building costs covering a range of personal care and branded packaged food products are reflected under
'Other expenses' stated above and in SeQment Results under 'FMCG-Others'. 
3.
10,48,850 Ordinary Shares oft 1/- each were issued and allotted under the Company's Employee Stock Option Schemes during the quarter
ended 30th September, 2026. Consequently, the issued and paid-up Share Capital of the Company stands increased tot 1253,05,17,081/­
as on 30th September, 2026.
4.
The Group on 1st August, 2026 completed acquisition of the pulp and paper business of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, operated under the 
name of 'Century Pulp and Paper', along with the assets, liabilities, contracts, employees etc., as a going concern on a slump sale basis, in
accordance with the Business Transfer Agreement dated 31st March, 2025.
The fair value of assets and liabilities of 'Century Pulp and Paper' have been provisionally determined and recorded in accordance with Ind AS
103 - 'Business Combinations'. Accordingly, the financial results of the Group and 'Paperboards, Paper & Packaging' segment include those
of 'Century Pulp and Paper' from 1st August, 2026 and consequently are not comparable with previous periods.
5.
Sproutlife Foods Private Limited ('Sproutlife') became a subsidiary of the Company with effect from 1st April, 2026, consequent to the 
Company acquiring the right to nominate majority of Directors on its Board. 
In accordance with Ind AS 103 - Business Combinations, the Group has re-measured its existing interest in Sproutlife at fair value. 
The fair values of assets and liabilities of Sproutlife have been provisionally determined and recorded in accordance with Ind AS 103 -
Business Combinations and have been reflected in 'FMCG - Others' segment. The financial results of the Group and 'FM CG-Others' segment 
include those of Sproutlife with effect from 1st April, 2026. Accordingly, results of the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 are
not comparable with previous periods. 
The Company on 28th September, 2026 acquired additional 13,445 Equity Shares of t10/- each of Sproutlife, consequent to which Sproutlife
became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with effect from the said date.
Further, the Board of Directors of the Company at the meeting held today i.e. 2nd November, 2026 has approved, subject to necessary
approvals, the Scheme of Amalgamation of Sproutlife with the Company under Sections 230 and 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.
6.
Exceptional Items for the six months ended 30th September, 2026 oft 380.22 Crores represents : 
a) expenses of t 25.66 crores during the quarter ended 30th September, 2026 incurred in relation to the acquisition of the pulp and paper
business of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, operated under the name of 'Century Pulp and Paper' (Refer Note 4 above).
b) gain of t 405.88 crores during the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 on remeasurement of existing interest in Sproutlife at fair value in 
accordance with Ind AS 103 - Business Combinations (Refer Note 5 above). 
Exceptional Items for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2025 of t 88.08 crores represent final settlement of the insurance 
claim towards leaf tobacco stocks, which were destroyed due to fire at a third party owned warehouse in an earlier year. 
7.
Consequent to expiry of the GST Compensation Cess, the Government of India increased GST and Central Excise duty on cigarettes with
effect from 1st February, 2026. In accordance with Ind AS 115 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers and Schedule Ill to the Companies
Act, 2013, GST and GST Compensation Cess are excluded from Gross Revenue from sale of products, whereas Excise duty is not excluded.
Consequently, Gross Revenue from sale of products and services and Excise duty for the quarters ended 30th September, 2026, 30th June,
2026 and six months ended 30th September, 2026 reflect the impact of sharp increase in Excise duty and are not strictly comparable with 
those of the previous periods. 
8.
This statement is as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
Limited Review
